dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, interconnected 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast light-colored perimeters exhibiting crenulated edges that sharply transition to a dark-tone interior and exterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, discrete light-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated on the head, neck, and lower anterior flank region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form a network of irregular polygons and non-equilateral triangles across the mid-section of the subject.
